subject: Multi-session conditional likelihood with missing covariate values

messages.author: ac711cfc7e742bce
messages.subject: Multi-session conditional likelihood with missing covariate values
parts:
secr lets me fit single session models with conditional likelihood using the hcov command to estimate sex ratio and include sex effects on detection parameters, but it tells me I can't have missing covariate values when I move to multi-session.  Is there a good reason for this?

Thanks.

Ben
